note: Round eight, seven lands and five Treasures on the battlefield and two more lands in hand, with the commander Mary Read and Anne Bonny out: cast Unexpected Windfall, and discard the Island to it. Her trigger makes a tapped Treasure for a discarded Island, Pirate or Vehicle card, so the Island is the cheapest card in hand (ADR 0126 §7 and its discard_payoff amendment of 2026-10-06). The Mountain is unlabelled: worse, not wrong. Breeches is a Pirate and would make the same Treasure, but it is a castable creature against a spare land, so the Treasure does not close the gap; Negate and Bident of Thassa are not spare either. The view's discard_payoff rows were stamped onto the capture when the field was added.
